in_marathi.name: Apsha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of water
in_marathi.long_meaning: Apsha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Apsha is the Sanskrit name of the goddess of water, often depicted as a beautiful woman with a water pot. She is considered the source of all creation and is worshipped for prosperity, purification, and healing. In Hindu mythology, Apsha is the wife of Lord Maruti, the god of wind.
